execution_flows.name: Order Creation & Async Webhook Dispatch
steps: FastAPI validates inbound JSON via CreateOrderRequest (extra='forbid', normalized uppercase SKU).
create_order() resolves OrderDispatcherService via Depends(get_dispatcher) and converts lines via to_domain_lines().
OrderDispatcherService.place_order() calls compute_order_total_cents() for integer-cent subtotal and VIP discount.
AsyncWebhookClient.notify_order_accepted() posts event with explicit timeout_sec=5.0, degrading to WEBHOOK_DEFERRED on httpx.HTTPError.
OrderRepository.save() persists finalized OrderRecord and to_order_response() returns HTTP 201 JSON.

execution_flows.name: Readiness Probe & Order Lookup
steps: GET /healthz returns ServiceSettings metadata as frozen HealthResponse (HTTP 200).
GET /v1/orders/{order_id} queries OrderDispatcherService.find_order() -> OrderRepository.get() and raises HTTP 404 when absent.

state_and_storage: Application-scoped dependencies stored on FastAPI app.state during asynccontextmanager lifespan (src/order_dispatch/main.py).
Default persistence adapter is process-local InMemoryOrderRepository behind OrderRepository Protocol (src/order_dispatch/infra/repository.py).
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Asyncio event loop via Uvicorn + FastAPI with non-blocking httpx.AsyncClient; domain invariant violations raise PricingError, missing lookups raise HTTPException(404), and outbound webhook httpx.HTTPError failures degrade gracefully to OrderStatus.WEBHOOK_DEFERRED with warning logs.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain CVEs, Container Misconfigs, Secrets, Dangerous Sinks & API Boundaries
audit_dimensions.summary: Trivy SCA across filesystem and the built python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm image found 0 CRITICAL/HIGH CVEs in order-dispatch's declared application dependencies (fastapi, pydantic, uvicorn, httpx), 0 secrets, and only 1 LOW IaC warning (DS-0026 missing HEALTHCHECK). However, the pinned Debian 12.7 base image bundles outdated pip@24.2 (5 MEDIUM + 1 LOW CVEs) and 612 OS package CVEs (9 CRITICAL, 158 HIGH) fixable by refreshing the base image and upgrading/removing build-time pip in a multi-stage Dockerfile.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Live HTTP Penetration Findings, Security Headers & Endpoint Defenses
audit_dimensions.summary: Live HTTP DAST penetration test against the isolated Docker container (19 probes: 15 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped) confirmed zero critical or high exploitable vulnerabilities (XSS, SQLi, path traversal, secret leaks all resisted). Three medium/low defense-in-depth findings were verified live: unauthenticated POST /v1/orders returning HTTP 201 (CWE-306), publicly accessible /openapi.json (CWE-200), and missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header (CWE-693).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: order-dispatch provides a clean, deterministic, offline-safe pytest suite (3 test files, 4 test functions, 0 assertion-free tests, 100.0% static module coverage, 85.2% measured line coverage, 62.5% branch coverage) using an explicit _StubWebhookClient to avoid external network calls. Expanding tests/test_routes.py with FastAPI TestClient calls and AsyncWebhookClient MockTransport tests will lift branch coverage from 62.5% above 80%.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Isolated Docker runtime verification passed all 4 gates: both project Dockerfile (31.33s) and uv harness (0.48s) built cleanly, 4/4 offline pytest tests passed (--network=none, 5.05s), measured pytest-cov reached 85.2% line / 62.5% branch coverage, and ASGI lifespan smoke check booted cleanly (/healthz -> 200). Targeted branch tests for routes.py (56.0% line), webhook_client.py (55.6% line), and main.py lifespan (67.9% line) will raise branch coverage above 80%.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate 12-Factor Config/Statelessness & SRE PRR Timeouts/Observability
audit_dimensions.summary: order-dispatch demonstrates strong 12-Factor and SRE Production Readiness compliance: centralized pydantic-settings configuration (ORDER_DISPATCH_*), swappable OrderRepository Protocol and AsyncWebhookClient ports, explicit 5.0s httpx timeout, structured stdlib logging, asynccontextmanager lifespan, and /healthz readiness endpoint. Production hardening requires replacing InMemoryOrderRepository with a durable backing store for horizontal stateless scaling and adding authentication on /v1/orders.

findings.description: Trivy image scan on python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm (Debian 12.7) reports 9 CRITICAL / 158 HIGH Debian OS CVEs (e.g., CVE-2026-42010 in libgnutls30, CVE-2026-31789 in openssl/libssl3), 6 pip@24.2 CVEs (CVE-2026-8643 et al.), and DS-0026 missing HEALTHCHECK.
findings.recommendation: Refresh the base image to the latest patched python:3.12.x-slim-bookworm (or distroless/multi-stage uv copy), remove/upgrade pip to >=26.2.0, and add a HEALTHCHECK against /healthz.

findings.description: POST /v1/orders (create_order) and GET /v1/orders/{order_id} (get_order) have no OAuth2/JWT/API-key Depends() guard, matching the TODO(security) marker at line 73.
findings.recommendation: Add a FastAPI Security/Depends() caller authentication and per-tenant authorization dependency to /v1/orders endpoints.

findings.description: Live probe test_app_probes::test_create_order_enforces_authentication_guard sent an unauthenticated POST /v1/orders request and received HTTP 201 with a created order_id.
findings.recommendation: Require OAuth2/JWT or API-key authentication via FastAPI Depends() on /v1/orders endpoints before public exposure.

findings.description: main.py instantiates InMemoryOrderRepository by default during FastAPI lifespan startup, which is clean for local/test execution behind OrderRepository Protocol but will not share order state across multiple replicas.
findings.recommendation: Provide a durable external OrderRepository implementation (e.g., PostgreSQL/Redis) selectable via ServiceSettings when env == 'prod'.
